symbol.title: Honey-fisher on the summit crag, golden rod over the human sea
Stone slab with two cast shadows above a crying sea
Two kings following their laden ass down the path
Forearm in the swamp bearing ten leeches
Prostrate sorcerer under a mocking eye; a fallen mask at the frame edge
Blessing hand; forest hut with wolves; the blind eye
Serpent's Death valley: black and ember cliffs, the turned-away witness
Three cows above the sermonizer on the hillock
Six legs diminishing along the ridge; cold mirrors behind
Noontide sleep under the vine inside the golden round ring
The Higher Men assembled in the cave mouth; eagle above, pine beside
The last supper table seen from above
The Sign-Ring: ember disc rekindling to gold
Harp whose strings become panther and eagle under a crescent moon
The oasis-mouth: palm dancer, distant lion, veiled faces in the reeds
Seven kneeling figures ring the haloed ass; incense rises
The ass enthroned amid dancing Higher Men under festival bunting
The midnight bell in its tower above the round midnight disc
The laughing lion and the doves at sunrise: the Sign
Sun-rule: opener rule with center sun-dot
Festival double-rule with rose-wreath medallion
Ember-ring chapter close
Lion-and-doves chapter close
